chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Dawud ibn Sirhan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The witness should not refuse to answer when summoned, before the written record is drawn up.
ai.seo_question: What is the obligation of a witness when summoned to testify before the written record is made?
ai.summary: In the context of *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith clarifies the procedural timeline for witness testimony, distinguishing between the oral declaration (*shahada*) and the subsequent written record (*kitab*). It underscores the juristic principle that a witness cannot refuse to testify merely because the formal documentation process has not yet commenced, ensuring the integrity of the evidentiary chain in Shia legal methodology. This ruling highlights the immediacy of the witness's duty upon valid summons, prior to any administrative formalities.
